narrative.text: The full text of WHO recommendations on maternal health (updated May 2017), a compilation of guidance approved by the WHO Guidelines Review Committee, opening with the copyright page, contents and abbreviations. The introduction explains that it is one of four compilations, with others on newborn, child and adolescent health, intended to give staff, policy-makers and health professionals easy access to the recommendations and to identify guidance gaps. The listed sections cover antenatal care, prevention of pre-eclampsia, preterm birth outcomes, peripartum infections, labour and childbirth, postpartum haemorrhage prevention, postnatal care and health promotion. A second part addresses management of conditions such as postpartum haemorrhage, pre-eclampsia, infections, HIV, malaria and tuberculosis, ending with graded nutrition and micronutrient recommendations for pregnant and lactating women with active TB.
